ja443:1.1: Yo te imaṃ visālakkhiṃ piyaṃ sammillabhāsiniṃ ādāya balā gaccheyya kin nu kayirāsi brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja443:2.1: Uppajja me na mucceyya na me mucceyya jīvato rajaṃ va vipulā vuṭṭhi khippam eva nivāraye ti.
ja443:3.1: Yan nu pubbe vikatthittho balamhi va apassito sv-ājja tuṇhikkhako dāni saṃghāṭiṃ sibbam acchasīti.
ja443:4.1: Uppajji me, na muccittha, na me mucceyya jīvato, rajaṃ va vipulā vuṭṭhi khippaṃ eva nivārayin ti.
ja443:5.1: Kin te uppajji no mucci, kin te no mucci jīvato, rajaṃ va vipulā vuṭṭhi katamaṃ tvaṃ nivārayīti.
ja443:6.1: Yamhi jāte na passati ajāte sādhu passati so me uppajji no mucci kodho dummedhagocaro.
ja443:7.1: Yena jātena nandanti amittā dukkhamesino so me uppajji no mucci kodho dummedhagocaro.
ja443:8.1: Yasmiñ ca jāyamānasmiṃ sadatthaṃ nāvabujjhati so me uppajji no mucci kodho dummedhagocaro.
ja443:9.1: Yenābhibhūto kusalaṃ jahāti parakkare vipulañ cāpi atthaṃ sa bhīmaseno balavā pamaddī kodho mahārāja na me amuccatha.
ja443:10.1: Kaṭṭhasmiṃ manthamānasmiṃ pāvako nāma jāyati, tam eva kaṭṭhaṃ ḍahati yasmā so jāyate gini.
ja443:11.1: Evaṃ mandassa posassa bālassa-m-avijānato sārambhā jāyate kodho, so pi ten' eva ḍayhati. [S. P. p. 299.)
ja443:12.1: Aggīva tiṇakaṭṭhasmiṃ kodho yassa pavaḍḍhati (Grimblot, nihīyati tassa yaso kāḷapakkhe va candimā.
ja443:13.1: Anedho dhūmaketu va kodho yass' upassammati āpūrati tassa yaso sukkapakkhe va candimā ti
